applies_to.notes: CLI 2.1.296 isolated actual claude plugin validate --help, missing-path (exit 1) and synthetic Mod with plugin directory (strict validation exit 0). Not real model or interactive host acceptance.

evidence.notes: M002 is the reviewed official static-validation documentation; exact required <path> syntax and missing-path exit code were independently reproduced with native Claude Code CLI 2.1.296 on MacBook Pro; see docs/reports/2026-10-16-chat-mode-native-plugin-validate-path.md. This is version-scoped and does not claim unverified later versions.

statement: Claude Code CLI 2.1.296 的 `claude plugin validate` 必须给出待验证 Mod 的插件目录路径。若在 Mod 根目录执行，可使用 `claude plugin validate --strict .`；也可传入经核对的 Mod 目录绝对/相对路径。仅运行 `claude plugin validate`，或追加 `--strict`/`--json` 但不提供路径时，CLI 会返回 `missing required argument 'path'`（退出码 1）。此参数规则不应与 `claude plugin test`（可以省略目录，默认当前目录）混淆；静态校验通过仍不能替代真实运行和独立测试。
subject: mods.types.plugin-validate-directory-required
